verdict.rationale: Full-stack app deployment is well documented: `fly launch` creates, configures and deploys an app from source, and Managed Postgres, global regions and `fly scale` round it out. However, Fly runs Docker images as Firecracker-style VMs (Machines and Sprites) rather than offering a true serverless-functions model. Developers still handle machine-level concerns such as restart policies, scaling and running multiple instances to survive host failures, and community reports of flaky deploys and stuck instances lower confidence in the hands-off experience. Missing for 10: a native serverless function (FaaS) offering, a genuinely no-servers-to-manage abstraction, and built-in scheduled tasks/cron.
